-- Auditoria de calidad de bronze (visible en la salida de la actividad).
-- Los residuos que aqui aparezcan son filas que silver filtrara por diseño.
SELECT 'Rutas' AS Tabla, COUNT(*) AS Filas,
       SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(RutaHistoricaId)), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SinId
FROM bronze.Rutas
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Paradas', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ParadaHistoricaId)), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM bronze.Paradas
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Vehiculos', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(VehiculoId)), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM bronze.Vehiculos
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Viajes', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(ViajeId)), '') IS NULL
                                  OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(RutaHistoricaId)), '') IS NULL
                                  OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(VehiculoId)), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM bronze.Viajes
UNION ALL
SELECT 'DemandaParadas', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(DemandaId)), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM bronze.DemandaParadas
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Incidentes', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(IncidenteId)), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM bronze.Incidentes
UNION ALL
SELECT 'IncidenteRuta', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(IncidenteId)), '') IS NULL
                                        OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(RutaHistoricaId)), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM bronze.IncidenteRuta;
